objective: Test whether predictive same-canonical prearm can hide normal scheduler latency under predecessor useful work without dual substantive authority.
acceptance_criteria: Same canonical predictive continuation is armed and verified without changing the 780s cold-rescue horizon.
Predecessor continues useful work through bounded close rather than yielding to the arm.
Any early successor is fenced from conflicting substantive takeover.
Next wake can measure predecessor-last-useful to successor-first-useful gap without inferred timestamps.
checkpointable_substeps: Establish the mathematical P0 cadence ceiling and select predictive prearm by expected effect.
Implement predictive-overlap safety control and durable canary ledger.
Arm PREARM-CANARY-001 for target-close minus 30s and continue useful predecessor work.
Persist predecessor close boundary and let successor classify the observed handoff.
handoff_boundary: Target bounded close 2026-09-21T17:11:46+09:00 after a final useful checkpoint; predictive due is 17:11:16 and does not itself authorize predecessor idle/return.
early_finish_fallback: Verify integrated control-plane CI and tighten canary evidence/rollback semantics without broadening outside P001.
